problem: Erdos #126: log g(k) = o(k), where g(k) = max |A| over k-prime sets S with all off-diagonal sums of A being S-smooth
verdict: no counterexample construction found; the tensor lane is closed conditionally on subexponential S-unit solution counts

theorems.statement: If A is admissible for S and P(c) is a subset of S, then cA is admissible for S with |cA| = |A|.
theorems.consequence: optimal witnesses are unbounded; the parent's 'optima are tiny' claim is a branch-order artifact

theorems.statement: g(k) >= floor((p_{k+1}-1)/2) = (1/2 + o(1)) k log k, via A = {1,...,m} with S the first k primes.
theorems.consequence: first asymptotic lower bound in this hunt family; superlinear, far from exponential

theorems.statement: If g(k+k0) >= c*g(k) for some fixed k0>=1, c>1 and all large k, then liminf log g(k)/k >= log(c)/k0 > 0 and #126 is false.
theorems.consequence: the refutation bar is a bounded-prime-cost doubling gadget, far weaker than the parent's supermultiplicative composition law

theorems.statement: There are non-decreasing G with limsup log G(k)/k > 0 for which every uniform law G(k+k0) >= c G(k) fails off a density-zero set (staircase G(k) = 2^{k_j} on [k_j, k_{j+1})).
theorems.consequence: an anti-composition theorem is NOT sufficient for #126; corrects the parent's closing framing

theorems.statement: If C = A.B is admissible for S union T, then for every a != a' in A and b != b' in B, x = (ab+a'b')/((a+a')(b+b')) and y = (ab'+a'b)/((a+a')(b+b')) solve x + y = 1 in positive (S union T)-units.
theorems.identity: u + v = (a+a')(b+b'),  u - v = (a-a')(b-b'),  u = ab+a'b', v = ab'+a'b

theorems.statement: |A| and |B| are each at most N(S union T) + 1, where N is the number of solutions of x+y=1 in S-units, by Mobius injectivity of x in the ratio b/b'.
theorems.conditional_strength: if N(S) = exp(o(|S|)) then no tensor construction is exponential; an exponential tensor forces N(S) >= exp(ck), beating Erdos-Stewart-Tijdeman's exp(c (s/log s)^{1/2})

theorems.statement: 2|A| - 3 <= Psi(2 max A, S); sharper, |A| - 1 <= #{S-smooth in (max A, 2 max A]}.
theorems.consequence: too weak to obstruct: it only forces max A to exceed a polynomial in k. Recorded as a negative.

audit_of_parent.claim_refuted: 'every optimal witness has all elements < 50' - false by Lemma 1; independent search returns optima {113,399} at k=1 and {16,80,112,176} at k=2
audit_of_parent.framing_corrected: '#126 is asking for an anti-composition theorem' - overstated; see prop-4-no-converse

not_settled: no unconditional obstruction to any lane; the tensor closure is conditional on subexponential S-unit counts, itself open
CRT and recursive lanes considered but not developed; no theorem against them here
no upper bound on g(k) improving on Erdos-Turan 3*2^{k-1}
whether Lemma 2's (1/2) k log k is the best known lower bound - literature not searched
rh_relevance: none; nothing here is evidence for or against RH (docs/08)
